output.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.created_at)::int AS created_year, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM marts.dim_customers AS c GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.created_at)::int ORDER BY created_year
output.explanation: Counts customer accounts (one row per account in dim_customers) by the calendar year of created_at, which is also the fiscal year. All accounts are included, whether or not they have any orders.
